# Paris

Paris is the capital and largest city of [[France]]. It is located on the [[Seine]] river.

## Landmarks

The [[Eiffel Tower]] was designed by [[Gustave Eiffel]].
The [[Louvre Museum]] is the world's most-visited museum.

## Demographics

Population: 2.1 million in the city, 13 million in the [[Île-de-France]] metropolitan area.
